notes.title: Issue Regarding Runtimes - temporary fix
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Varistas,

Please be aware there's an issue going on right now with Varista when using other XR runtimes. Currently the Steam one is working (the most widely available one for Varista right now)
If your hands are looking a little weird when you load up the game try the following:

Step 1) With or without your headset on you can open steam VR (if you do it from your desktop a little window will open)
Step 2) Go to the settings page 
Step 3) Click on OpenXR and then Set SteamVR as openXR runtime

This will allow you to play open xr games on your steam device (including varista) 

You will be able to switch this anytime back to your respective runtime device on their local homepage/settings

I am sorry for any inconvenience! And I am presently working on a fix.

Regards,

The PomDev Team

notes.title: Update to allow users to play with SteamVR Runtime
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Varistas,

I have worked out a solution that seems to have resolved the issues with SteamVR not working (hands were typically stuck in the ground.) 

I have since added a fix so Varista should work when launched through steam on OpenXR platforms including SteamVR and Oculus.

Thank you for your continued support, if you have anymore issues please let me know on our community page or on our discord at: https://discord.gg/cS7JcQprES

Sincerely,

The PomDev Team

notes.title: Fixing Issue with SteamVR Not Recognizing Hands
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Varistas!

Unfortunately, during development I ran into some issues learning to use OpenXR and how that works at runtime with SteamVR and the likes. I have found a fix for it and I am applying it tomorrow I am just ironing out some issues I had after the update but it seems so far to have resolved the hands being stuck to the ground at the start of the game for people using SteamVR as their default runtime. I will be back with hopefully the patch and an update tomorrow.

Thank you for being patient, hopefully you are enjoying all the demos being provided during Steam Next Fest!

PomDev Team

notes.title: Varista VR Developer Playtest for Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
☕🍰 Welcome to a world where coffee is an art and customer satisfaction is the ultimate goal! ☕👩‍🍳

Prepare to step into the charming café of Varista, the VR coffee-making and customer-serving sensation created by the talented solo developer at PomDev! ☕🎮

Join us for an exclusive live stream during Steam Next Fest, where we'll transport you straight into the heart of this cozy café simulator. In this limited yet tantalizing demo, you'll experience the thrill of taking orders, crafting delicious coffees, and serving up mouthwatering pastries to your virtual patrons.

While we may be confined to one scene, it's packed with the essence of café life, from the cheerful chitchat of customers to delightful ambient music as you serve your customers. You'll get a taste of what it's like to be the ultimate barista in the making!

And stay tuned, as we'll be sharing some pro tips, tricks, and showcasing how even in this small slice of Varista, every decision you make counts. It's all about serving that perfect cup of coffee and creating a delightful customer experience.

So, set your virtual stage and prep those orders, because in Varista, every moment matters. See you at the Varista live stream, where the coffee's hot, and the fun's brewing! ☕🍰🎉 #VaristaCafe #PomDevBrews #SteamNextFest
